name: Mattermost Inbox (Outlook Sync)
description: Syncs O365 Outlook emails with Mattermost channels. Users see incoming emails as threaded posts and can reply to emails from within Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Configure the Mattermost Inbox plugin to sync O365 Outlook emails with Mattermost.
settings_schema.footer: Register an Azure AD application at https://portal.azure.com with permissions: Mail.Read, Mail.Send, offline_access. Set the redirect URI to {siteURL}/plugins/com.mattermost.plugin-inbox/api/v1/oauth2/complete.

settings.help_text: The Azure AD tenant ID. Use 'common' for multi-tenant apps.
The application (client) ID of the registered Azure AD app.
The client secret generated in the Azure AD app registration.
Auto-generated AES-256 key used to encrypt OAuth tokens at rest. Regenerating this key will disconnect all users.
settings.regenerate_help_text: Regenerating this key will invalidate all stored tokens and disconnect all users.

settings.help_text: Secret used as the clientState for Microsoft Graph webhook subscriptions to validate incoming notifications.
settings.regenerate_help_text: Regenerating this secret will require re-creating all active subscriptions.

settings.help_text: How often to poll for new emails as a fallback when webhooks are unavailable. Set to 0 to disable polling. Default: 5.
Maximum size of email attachments to download and upload to Mattermost. Attachments exceeding this size will show a link only. Default: 50.
When true, additional diagnostic logging is enabled.
